note: The High unprotected `trunk` path was judged overstated: `docker.yaml` runs on every push but its Docker Hub login, signing and push steps carry `if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')`, so a push to the branch reaches no secret, Low (the tag push is a separate insider entry); the High `geomys/sandboxed-step@v1.2.2` path was judged overstated: a mutable third-party action in a CI job with no secret and no write token (or only an assumed one) gives code execution on a runner, Medium at most. Corrected after reading the workflows: `chart-publish.yaml` publishes the Helm chart with `packages: write` on a push to `trunk`, so the branch entry holds at High; what the label still requires is that the tag-gated Docker Hub secrets are not counted.
